title: Download files
deleteAfterFirst: This transfer is deleted after its first complete download. To be sure to get every file, download them all at once with the ZIP archive.
noFiles: No file is available in this transfer.
integrity: The SHA-256 fingerprint lets you check that a downloaded file is intact: compare it with the fingerprint computed on your computer.

archive.hint: The archive is not compressed: its size is close to the total size of the files.

scan.summary: Some files could not be analysed by the antivirus. Open them only if you trust the sender.
scan.notScannedTooLarge: Not analysed by the antivirus: this file is too large to be analysed.
scan.notScannedEncrypted: Not analysed by the antivirus: this file is encrypted or protected by a password.

locked.title: Password required
locked.text: This transfer is protected by a password. The sender gives it to you through another channel than the email (phone, message…).
locked.label: Password
locked.locked: Too many wrong passwords: the transfer is locked for a while.
locked.unlocked: Transfer unlocked: the files are listed.
locked.unlockedAgain: You can enter the password again.
locked.expired: Your access to the files has expired: enter the password again.

notFound.title: Transfer not found
notFound.text: This download link is not valid. Check that you copied it completely from the email.

gone.title: Transfer no longer available
gone.text: This transfer has expired or has been deleted. Ask the sender to send the files again.
